recentItems.title: Trump Vs El-Sayed Turns Ugly As Haley Stevens Drops Republican Shocker | US' Michigan Midterm Battle
recentItems.description:
Just days before Americans head to the ballot box on November 3, Michigan has become one of the most explosive battlegrounds of the 2026 US midterm elections. What was supposed to be a contest between a Democrat hoping to flip a Republican-held Senate seat and a Trump-backed Republican has now turned into something far more complicated. Personal attacks, accusations of antisemitism, a bitter internal Democratic feud and an extraordinary political betrayal have transformed this election into a full-blown political drama. At the centre of the storm is Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee who is facing Republican Mike Rogers. But El-Sayed is fighting battles on several fronts. President Donald Trump has joined the verbal assault against him, while a Democrat who once wanted the same Senate seat, Congresswoman Haley Stevens, has delivered perhaps the biggest shock of the campaign by endorsing Rogers just 48 hours before voting. So why has this Michigan election become so personal? What exactly triggered the extraordinary confrontation between El-Sayed and Stevens? And could a Democratic civil war hand Republicans a crucial Senate victory? So come along and watch this edition of From The News Desk till the very end because we will explain why the Michigan mess is not just about 1 seat.
